title: Make Application accept any Journal implementation
goal: Make ymp_runtime::Application accept any current ymp_kernel::Journal implementation while preserving the existing in-memory entry point, removing the MemoryJournal coupling from runtime assembly without selecting or implementing persistent storage.
scope: Parameterize Application assembly in crates/ymp-runtime/src/lib.rs over the current Journal port.
Preserve Application::in_memory(), Application::default(), and Application::new(MemoryJournal) exactly for existing consumers.
Add an alternative Journal test double in crates/ymp-runtime/tests/foundation.rs whose behavior is observable through the public Application surface.
acceptance: Application can be constructed with a non-MemoryJournal implementation of the current Journal trait and routes open_session, read_session, and cancel_session through Dispatcher without adapter-specific branches.
The alternate-adapter test observes the adapter's typed failure or state at the public Application boundary and would not pass against the hard-coded assembly.
Application::in_memory(), Application::default(), and existing Application::new(MemoryJournal) consumers retain current behavior with no source changes outside the two allowed files.
No event, revision, Journal, MemoryJournal, storage, CLI, or user-facing semantics change and no dependency is added.
cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings, and cargo test --workspace --offline pass.
evidence: Result commit 9ab947575e3457b8a05b7174100b891904df8b96 on main (feat: make Application generic over Journal implementations (DEV-0011))
Accepted-bytes and diff SHA-256 verification against the accept package (lib.rs 37de9bdf..., foundation.rs 34bd42c0..., diff cab299a6...)
context: Preparatory work for DEV-0005 extracted by independent work order; it does not start or complete DEV-0005.
Allowed files: crates/ymp-runtime/src/lib.rs and crates/ymp-runtime/tests/foundation.rs only.
